assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: polished product concept board for Zactiv Family, a simple family activity app.
Primary request: Create a wide editorial design board showing three large, flat front-on mobile app screens side by side with short captions. Professional, legible app design, cream #f6f1e7 background, electric blue #0000ff primary buttons and text accents, dark navy #091d39 body text, orange #ffa500 details. Warm cut-paper illustrations and spacious rounded cards. Parent friendly and playful without babyish clutter.
Screen 1 titled "A little adventure, together". Header "zactiv family". Small segmented choices "5 min", "10 min", "20 min". Main illustrated card "Animal parade" with a friendly cut-paper fox and bird. Metadata "5 min · Indoors · No kit". Primary button "Let's play". Small alternate link "Try another". Below, three path markers, two filled: "2 of 3 moments this week".
Screen 2 titled "Take turns being the animal". Card with two accessible options "Move around" and "Play seated". Illustration of varied family members copying animal poses in a living room. Large simple step "1. Choose an animal". Subtitle "Everyone copies. Then swap leaders." Primary button "We tried it". No scores, no tracking, no camera.
Screen 3 titled "That was time well spent". Small celebratory star burst, no excessive confetti. Illustrated simple trail with three filled nodes and family flag. Text "3 little moments together". A small sticker "Animal parade". Optional question "Want to remember anything?" with choices "Funny", "Calm", "Energetic", and button "Done for today".
Caption below the three phones respectively: "ONE GOOD IDEA", "PLAY TOGETHER", "KEEP THE MEMORY".
Constraints: realistic usable mobile UI proportions, readable large typography, no gradients, no huge dashboards, no dark mode, no charts or paywalls, no third party logos, no realistic device renders, no watermarks. Layout should feel designed rather than generic. Mockup only, not a claim of implemented screens.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: alternative Zactiv Family design direction board.
Primary request: High fidelity wide two-screen mobile interface concept board for a family activity app called zactiv family. Explore a private family scrapbook and an optional paid weekend adventure pack, retaining cream #f6f1e7, navy #091d39, electric blue #0000ff actions and orange #ffa500 accents. Spacious, elegant Futura-like typography, cheerful original cut-paper art, editorial simplicity.
Left screen: header "zactiv family", large title "Look what we did together." Subtitle "Little memories, all yours." A simple grid of 4 charming original illustrated stickers labelled "Animal parade", "Mirror moves", "Colour explorers", "Our picnic". Fox, mirrored hand shapes, leaf, basket. Below one memory card "We took turns leading." with "This week" label. Small optional note input, then "Find a little idea" primary button. No child photos, no profiles, no statistics, no currency.
Right screen: header "For grown-ups", large title "Great for free. More to explore." Top small card "Everyday adventures" with three checkmarks "Unlimited starter games", "Family trail and memories", "Seated versions included". Lower original illustration of a friendly paper rocket, moon and stars on navy. Title "Space explorers", text "Six family missions + printable star chart". Price "£5.99", subtitle "One-off pack. No renewal." One plain outlined button "Try a free preview". Footer "Your free adventures stay free." This is an adult purchase concept, not pressure aimed at children.
Below the screens captions "KEEP THE MEMORY" and "SELL AUTHORED ADVENTURES".
Constraints: flat front-on interface artboards with thin navy frame, no photorealistic phones, no third party mascots, no watermark, no gradients, no crowded UI, all instructions and labels clear and readable. Do not show subscription badges or locked earned rewards.
